quarterly_data.quarter: Schneider Electric press release: Schneider Electric and Apple introduce new Smart Thermostat (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Schneider Electric announced a Smart Thermostat co-developed with Apple for Apple Home Collection (with Room Sensors) and an exclusive Power Mount for the new Apple HomeView (Wall Mounted) in three configurations (USB-C Wall Connector, AC Wired, PoE Wired), within its Schneider Home residential portfolio. The USB-C Wall Connector and AC Wired Power Mounts can be ordered on Apple.com, with availability in Apple Retail Stores beginning Friday, November 13; customers in the U.S. and Canada can purchase the Smart Thermostat and Room Sensors in the Apple Store beginning early next year, and the PoE Wired Power Mount can be purchased beginning early next year. The company says its technologies are found in 4 out of 10 U.S. homes today.
quarterly_data.figure: Smart Thermostat MSRP $199.99; Room Sensor $39.99; Power Mounts $59.99 / $79.99 / $129.99 (U.S.)
